main.label: The clock-overflow abort fired before the graceful reset could
main.explanation: The borg clock sits exactly on the abort threshold (BORG_TIME_MAX - 3000). The original deactivates the borg there (borg_oops, clock overflow), about 2900 turns before the graceful reset threshold in borg_think can ever fire, so the borg stops and the clock stays frozen. The correction resets the clock in place and keeps playing; the borg_think overflow check remains as a failsafe.
